authority: Operator-approved NIED-listed 2018 NSSCO Physics syllabus; source pages retained on every outcome.
granularity_note: 28 teaching topics group the original syllabus sections. Named multi-member outcomes have source-bullet containers and member outcomes. Closely related operations stay together when they are a single teaching/practice skill. Illustrative examples are not universal item quotas. Containers receive overview teaching; member outcomes receive targeted practice. Formula layout is repaired only in learner_objective; source wording remains verbatim.
papers_note: Papers on objectives designate the planned practice strand: foundational investigation topics 2–3 are C/P3; other topics mainly A/B/P1–P2. Practical applications of content remain integrated in P3 tasks. These routes are planner judgements, not an official assignment of every source bullet to one paper.
